channel.title: Marmot Updates
channel.description: Release feed for Marmot — new entries are added by scripts/make-appcast-entry.sh

item.title: Marmot 1.0.4
item.description: • Clearer help when uninstalling an app is blocked. macOS only lets Marmot remove other apps if you turn on Marmot under App Management in System Settings. When that's off, the results now say so and show an Open Settings button that takes you straight there. Quit and reopen Marmot after turning it on.

item.title: Marmot 1.0.3
item.description:
• Startup items work again in the downloaded app. Marmot 1.0.2 couldn't ask macOS for permission to read your login items, so the list came up empty. Marmot can now ask, and the one-time Automation prompt appears the first time you open Startup.
  • Moving files to the Trash is more reliable. When Marmot can't move something to the Trash directly, it asks Finder to do it. That fallback was blocked in 1.0.2 and works again.

item.title: Marmot 1.0.2
item.description:
Marmot is now signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

Download the disk image, open it, and drag Marmot into Applications. Existing installs can also update through Marmot’s built-in update check. The Homebrew cask uses the disk image.

Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 26 or newer.

item.title: Marmot 1.0.1
item.description:
A safety fix for the protection that keeps your important files out of every cleanup.

  • Protected folders stay protected, however a path is written. Marmot checks every item again right before removing it, and never touches areas like your device backups, Documents, Photos, Mail or keychains. A path written with an extra "." in it (for example Application Support/./MobileSync) could slip past that last check even though it points into a protected folder. Marmot now refuses such paths outright.
  • Nothing else changes in how you use Marmot. Your settings, History and Autopilot rules are kept.

item.title: Marmot 1.0.0
item.description:
Marmot 1.0.0 is a fresh start for the free, open-source Mac cleaner that shows you everything before it changes anything. It's the same app, with a new version number and a clean release history.

  • Clean: Cleanup, Autopilot, Duplicates and Big Files free up space. Every change is a plan you review first, with a dry run, and removals go to the Trash so you can restore them from History.
  • Apps: the Uninstaller removes apps along with their leftovers, with Reset and Time Capsule. Unused Apps and App Updates help with the rest.
  • System: Disk Map, Startup Items, Maintenance, Live Status and the menu bar monitor show what's happening on your Mac.
  • Already using Marmot? This update installs over your current version and keeps your settings, History and Autopilot rules.
  • Homebrew: install with brew install --cask kasakir-ai/tap/marmot. If you installed from the old kasakir-ai/marmot tap, follow the one-time steps in the tap's README.
  • Requires macOS 26 (Tahoe) or later.
